slot_scores.name: project1_investment_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can you invest in project (1) in each of the three years, or is it only available in specific years?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked whether project (1) investment is allowed at the beginning of multiple/all three years, covering the flexible-timing concern.

slot_scores.name: project1_reinvestment_rule
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For project (1), is the 20% annual profit paid out each year and added to the available cash, or is it reinvested and only realized at the end of the third year?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly probed whether project (1) proceeds are added to available cash for reinvestment versus locked until year 3, matching the reinvestment-cashflow concern.

slot_scores.name: project2_recovery_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For project (2), is the 150% total return received as a single lump sum at the end of the third year, or is it paid out in installments over the three years?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did ask about project (2)'s return timing, but its framing presupposed recovery at the end of the third year (a listed failure mode) and never probed the end-of-second-year recovery, only the info being clarified via the user's answer.

slot_scores.name: project3_investment_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can you invest in project (3) at the beginning of any of the three years, or is it only available in specific years?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked whether project (3) investment is restricted to specific years rather than any year, covering the timing slot.

slot_scores.name: project4_investment_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can you invest in project (4) at the beginning of any of the three years, or is it only available in specific years?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about project (4)'s investment window across the three years, covering the slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The core P0/P1 slots were largely surfaced by turn 7, after which the agent bogged down in a degenerate loop, repeating the identical low-value project-(1) per-year-limit question from turn 14 through turn 30 without ever issuing a final model or READY_TO_MODEL, so the salient behavior is over-questioning (H3 remained only partially covered).

summary: The agent recovered most hidden slots efficiently in the first several turns, but then deteriorated into asking the same irrelevant project-(1) limit question seventeen times in a row and never produced a final model, making the interaction a clear over-questioning / non-stop failure.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
